summary.text: TALLBERG ELEKTRO AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 1981-07-01. TALLBERG ELEKTRO AS conducts trade and electrical installation, along with activities naturally connected to this, including participating in other companies with similar operations. Its main industry code is 43.210: electrical installation. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 23 230 016 NOK and the annual result was 254 497 NOK; operating income was down from 25 304 445 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -3 438 415 NOK in 2024 to 254 497 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from -4 535 508 NOK in 2024 to -3 781 011 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Patrick Mehren Janson (daglig leder) and Tore Hoff (styrets leder), with 2 other board members. Its verified website is tallberg.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn profiles. The registered employee count went from 22 on 2025-11-13 to 19 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
